title: Some Bamboo Grows Almost a Meter a Day
description: Some kinds of bamboo can grow close to a meter in a single day, making them among the fastest growing plants on Earth.

scenes.text: Some kinds of bamboo can grow almost a meter in a single day.
scenes.subject: bamboo
scenes.say: [excited] Some kinds of bamboo can grow almost a METER in a single day.

scenes.text: At that speed, you could almost see it moving if you watched closely for an hour.
scenes.subject: bamboo
scenes.say: [whispers] At that speed, you could almost see it moving if you watched closely for an hour.

scenes.text: Bamboo is not a tree. It is actually a giant kind of grass.
scenes.subject: bamboo
scenes.say: [gasps] Bamboo is not a tree. It is actually a giant kind of grass.

scenes.text: A new shoot does not add new sections as it grows. The sections it already has just stretch out, very fast.
scenes.subject: bamboo
scenes.say: A new shoot does not add new sections as it grows. The sections it already has just stretch out, very fast.

scenes.text: The world's fastest growing plant is a grass. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: bamboo
